{{Quote|See anything you like, give me a wink.|Gorv Mespit, to a customer|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Gorv Mespit''', also known as "'''Speck'''," was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]]<ref name="TOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] active during the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They sold [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and other items to fellow smugglers near the entrance to the [[Senate Commercial District]] in the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Mespit sold [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], [[Boot/Legends|boots]], [[Jacket/Legends|jackets]], and [[Belt/Legends|belts]], among which were articles of clothing resembling their own attire.<ref name="TOR" />

Mespit's skin was [[Color/Legends|green]], and they had Mirialan [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]], with some visible on the bridge of their [[Nose/Legends|nose]] above their [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]]. Mespit [[Language/Legends|spoke]] [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] to their customers. They wore a cream-colored outfit with patches of both dark and silver [[Armor/Legends|armor]], goggles over their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a dark [[Bandana/Legends|bandana]] over most of their face, cream-colored headgear, and green pants. Mespit had a blaster on each of their hips.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gorv Mespit first appeared as the Legacy vendor for the Smuggler class<ref name="TOR" /> in the [[2012]] Game Update 1.2 for<ref name="Update 1.2 Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20120329|text=Your Legacy Begins}}</ref> the [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" /> According to [[Jedipedia]]'s ''SWTOR'' database, the game files for Mespit's model identify them as having dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and green eyes.<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" />
